messages:
anu: Canary showing surge of 502s on model-proxy in ap-south after today's deploy. Pausing release. @omar can you take oncall?

deploybot: deploybot notice: Release 2405 -> PAUSED (reason: model-proxy 502 surge). To resume: `deploybot resume --release 2405`

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-399 (model-proxy ap-south). Oncall paged: @omar. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-399

omar: oncall here. quick scan: proxy CPU spike then upstream timeouts. No DB faults. agree pause.

kelly: option A = rollback to v3.2.0; option B = pin + temp config tweak (lower concurrency). prefer pin unless errors worsen.

anu: pin it. `release-manager pin 2405 --reason "INC-2026-399"`. also open a contingency change window for next day 10:00 UTC.

release-manager: Pin applied: 2405. State: PINNED (INC-2026-399).

omar: patching proxy config on canary: `max_workers 8` -> `4`. applying now, will report in 8m.

deploybot: Note: deploybot will not auto-rollback. Manual rollback: `deploybot rollback --release 2405 --to v3.2.0`

omar: config applied. 502s down from 18% -> 2.6%. latency OK.

anu: hold for 25m and re-evaluate. if <2% we'll resume a small canary (10% for 10m).@deploybot set check +25m.

deploybot: Confirmed: release 2405 PAUSED. Next check +25m.

ops-bot: Incident page updated; added mitigation steps and owner tags.

omar: 25m update: 502s ~1.3%. I recommend resuming canary at 10% for 10m.

anu: proceed: `deploybot resume --release 2405 --canary 10% --stages 10m`. Abort if >5% errors.

deploybot: Command accepted. Resuming release 2405 with canary 10% for 10m. Monitoring -> #slo-alerts.

kelly: I'll update release notes and add postmortem stub.

anu: thanks team. Keeping thread as canonical state. Will escalate to rollback only if errors cross thresholds. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: incident-triggered release hold and rescheduling
